user.title: Add Kuni
user.description: Sign in with the same email and password as the Kuni app (AWS Cognito). Every device on this account is added automatically. API host and organization are fixed in the integration code.

reauth_confirm.title: Re-authenticate Kuni
reauth_confirm.description: Your Kuni session expired. Sign in again with the same email and password as the Kuni app.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the API or login failed
error.no_devices: No devices were returned for this account
error.missing_dependency: The pycognito package could not be loaded. Restart Home Assistant after install.

abort.already_configured: This Kuni account is already configured

set_timer.name: Set timer
set_timer.description: Sets the run timer via shadow power (seconds as value; 0 clears).

device_id.name: Device
device_id.description: Kuni device, or use Targets → Device.

duration_seconds.name: Duration
duration_seconds.description: Seconds until auto-off (0–86400). Use 0 to clear.
